description: This file defines the ConfigurableLanguageManager class, which extends Drupal's LanguageManager to provide customized language management, including configuration overrides, language negotiation, and language type handling within the Drupal framework.

classes.name: ConfigurableLanguageManager
classes.description: Extends Drupal's LanguageManager to override default language management with configurable and negotiable language handling, including caching, configuration overrides, and module hooks.

methods.name: rebuildServices
methods.description: Invalidates the Drupal kernel container to rebuild services.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the language manager with dependencies and optional cache backend.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the language manager by loading defined language types and current languages.

methods.name: isMultilingual
methods.description: Checks if the site has more than one language configured.

methods.name: getLanguageTypes
methods.description: Returns configurable language types from configuration.

methods.name: getDefinedLanguageTypes
methods.description: Returns all defined language types.

methods.name: loadLanguageTypesConfiguration
methods.description: Loads language types from configuration storage.

methods.name: getDefinedLanguageTypesInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info about defined language types, allowing module alterations.

methods.name: saveLanguageTypesConfiguration
methods.description: Saves language type configuration values.

methods.name: getCurrentLanguage
methods.description: Gets the current language for a specified type, performing negotiation if needed.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the language manager's internal state, optionally for a specific language type.

methods.name: getNegotiator
methods.description: Returns the current language negotiator instance.

methods.name: setNegotiator
methods.description: Sets the language negotiator instance.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves the list of languages based on flags, with caching and configuration overrides.

methods.name: getNativeLanguages
methods.description: Returns native language objects, considering configuration overrides.

methods.name: updateLockedLanguageWeights
methods.description: Updates the weights of locked languages to maintain order.

methods.name: getFallbackCandidates
methods.description: Provides fallback language candidates based on site configuration and context.

methods.name: getLanguageSwitchLinks
methods.description: Generates language switch links using negotiation methods and allows module alterations.

methods.name: setConfigOverrideLanguage
methods.description: Overrides the configuration language.

methods.name: getConfigOverrideLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the current configuration override language.

methods.name: getLanguageConfigOverride
methods.description: Gets specific language configuration override.

methods.name: getLanguageConfigOverrideStorage
methods.description: Gets storage for language configuration override.

methods.name: getStandardLanguageListWithoutConfigured
methods.description: Returns a list of standard languages excluding configured ones.

methods.name: getNegotiatedLanguageMethod
methods.description: Returns the negotiation method used for a language type.
